title: The canonical topic article
encounter: A summary or exact pointer leads here
location: Canonical nested topic pages under docs/public; matching installed .yoke/docs paths
basis: Inspected topic homes and shared navigation contract
note: Concept, procedure, tutorial and reference can be distinct pages within a concept branch. Split by reader need before the 350-line authored-file ceiling.
current: Public topic homes now live in meaningful branches such as verification, projects, sessions and agents/rules. The navigation contract owns parentage, routes and heading fragments; verification owns exact candidate publication proof. Private operations retain their own authorized owner. Mapping a parent never proves child teaching.
desired: One owner per rule or recipe, meaningful nesting and breadcrumbs, valid release-matched pointers.
